properties: Measured in analyze_market_properties.py; chosen because sign is stable in train, validation AND test: (1) gap up >2% fades intraday, gap down >2% rebounds intraday; (2) HHV20+ER breakouts with signal-bar volume >=2x 20d mean have higher 20d forward return; (3) 120d momentum skipping 20d has positive cross-sectional spread.

levers.entry: buy_stop (HHV20 stop, prior ER) vs next_open_vol (Close breakout + ER + signal-bar volume>=1.5x prior 20d mean, next Open)
levers.gap_skip: skip buys whose Open is >2% above buy level/prior Close
levers.gapdown_close: pending exit with Open gap down >2% sells at that Close instead of Open
levers.rank: alphabetical vs higher momentum (Close t-21 / t-141) first

selection: Train spread: CAGR > base AND records >= base; max CAGR. Frozen. Every config is also run on later windows (post-freeze diagnostic) for lever-consistency table.
caution: Property sign checked on later periods before choosing levers -> later windows are not clean holdouts for lever choice; parameters (2%, 1.5x, 120d) set a priori, not tuned.
